review_notes: Read-only source audit except this new pure-data file. No real vLLM import on hub (package not installed); parent runs real-image import/inspect check separately. No execution, hardware or release claim.

Only observed stock frontend name defect in audited direct access paths: NativeControlClient used is_scheduler_paused on AsyncLLM; replace with async is_paused. EngineCore synchronous is_scheduler_paused is correct and must remain.

AsyncMPClient is the actual data_parallel_size=1 client chosen by EngineCoreClient.make_async_mp_client. The abstract EngineCoreClient does NOT provide call_utility_async/client_count/client_index; require those on actual AsyncMPClient, not abstract base.

Fields require real class source/MRO declarations; ctor fields such as client_count or process_inputs_async must not be tested with class hasattr. process_inputs_async is assigned make_async(self.process_inputs,...); no new fixture object proves its invocation.

optional_absent entries are guarded stock absences or E3 extension names installed by reviewed transforms/runtime. Their absence in pristine imports is expected, never grounds for a native-ready override. AsyncLLM.is_scheduler_paused is the forbidden legacy frontend spelling.

NativeSession uses the E3 NativeControlClient rather than a stock engine directly. ProbeSession delegates to ProbeController and uses ctl.engine.get_num_unfinished_requests, a real AsyncLLM synchronous API.
Native teacher frontend additionally consumes InputProcessor.process_inputs and constructor-created process_inputs_async; original *args/**kwargs are delegated unchanged.

Pause roundtrip: AsyncLLM.pause_generation awaits AsyncMPClient.pause_scheduler_async and output flush; CoreProc.pause_scheduler returns a Future until _pause_complete and _finish_pause. keep/clear_cache=False preserves cache. Signature check does not prove actual Future/IPC/stream behavior.

Potential separate E3 protocol issue: direct transition_acks/bootstrap_acks read replies currently lack clock while NativeControlClient._call requires it. Startup prepare uses ACKs embedded in transition replies and does not call these direct readers; not the native6 HTTP500.
No edits to existing files, no GPU/docker/box/network/imported vllm execution. Data source checked from pinned reference AST only; real imported class checker is parent-owned.
Worker.rank inherited from WorkerBase; GPUModelRunner.main_stream is functools.cached_property, not plain property.
BatchReqState passed to graph dispatch has has_prefill/is_prefilling_np/num_scheduled_tokens; it is distinct from InputBatch used by sampler.
All listed fields were proven declared on their class or pinned MRO. Conditional instance values/liveness require actual engine evidence; declarations do not create objects or certify lifecycle.
All required direct GPUModelRunner/Worker/Scheduler role accesses in assigned modules resolve. GPUModelRunner.rank is the one known absent stock lookup and is optional fallback only.
PP postprocess leaves are GPUModelRunner methods, not PPHandler.postprocess (absent). TraceReplayState field is trace_token_ids, never trace.
Parent should include E3 extension installer closure separately, not pretend _flash_* fields are stock class declarations.
